name: Forest Fling
source:
Submit your v-card to a noble woman in the forest. Player character is a timid young man. 

[From [url=https://dragulair.itch.io/forest-fling]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在森林里将你的童贞献给一位贵族淑女吧。玩家扮演的主角是一名腼腆害羞的年轻男子。

[摘自[url=https://dragulair.itch.io/forest-fling]itch.io[/url]]
